response.title: EPIC create
response.description: The body of POST /projects/api/entities, less its archetype ("archetype": "EPIC" is added beside these). The status is minted REPORTED by the writer.

assignee.description: Who is looking at it; free text.

acceptanceCriteria.description: What the work is accepted against, in order: short Markdown statements. The whole list is written at once; an empty list (or null on a patch) clears it. Frozen from READY_FOR_DEV on: restating the same list passes, a changed one is a 409.

items.description: Each item is one line of Markdown: not blank, no line break, at most one '.', and fewer than 20 whitespace characters.

project.description: The project the new EPIC goes in: its id or its slug.

response.title: FEATURE update
response.description: A JSON merge patch (RFC 7396) of one FEATURE, sent to PATCH /projects/api/entities/{id}: an absent property is left unchanged, null clears it. The status is moved through POST /projects/api/entities/{id}/status.

implementedAt.description: The implemented marker, an ISO-8601 instant. Moves only while the owning epic is READY_FOR_DEV or IMPLEMENTING.

implementingAt.description: The implementing marker, an ISO-8601 instant: when the implementation was started. Moves only while the owning epic is READY_FOR_DEV or IMPLEMENTING; history once implementedAt is set, so it is never cleared.

dependsOn.description: The id of the sibling this one waits for — ordering, never nesting.

response.title: TASK transition
response.description: The full post-state of one row turned into a TASK, one entry of POST /projects/api/entities/transition (keyed by the row's id, with "archetype": "TASK" beside these). An absent property is CLEARED, and an absent membership means a root.

repositoryId.description: The id of the one repository a task works in; it must be in the task's project.

implementedAt.description: The implemented marker, an ISO-8601 instant. Moves only while the owning epic is READY_FOR_DEV or IMPLEMENTING.

dependsOn.description: The id of the sibling this one waits for — ordering, never nesting.

membership.description: Where the row hangs: its parent, and its place among siblings.

parent.description: The id of a FEATURE (its UUID).

position.description: Zero-based place among the parent's children; absent appends it last.

response.message: No schema for door delete: it is create, update or transition
a FEATURE's parent must be an EPIC: <id:19> is a FEATURE
title must not be blank; project is required
Feature <id:19> does not move on its own while its epic <id:18> is REPORTED: the plan is still a draft — edit the feature or remove it, and its status moves to REFINED with the epic's.
